Trinity County

Land Area3,179 sq mi
Density5 / sq mi
Median Household Income$53,000
Median Home Value$330,000
Trinity County is mountainous, heavily forested and has no incorporated city, with Weaverville as its seat and the Trinity Alps filling its northern half. Timber and a cannabis economy in retreat leave a thin market, and with the Shasta-Trinity National Forest covering most of the county, development is limited to river-corridor communities along Highways 299 and 3.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: October 26, 2026
